_comment: Dedicated-server menu/store config. Copy to store.json and run: ags -config configs/store.json  (or pass any path). Every field is OPTIONAL — omit a field or leave a list empty to use the server's built-in defaults. NOTE: an empty list means 'use default', not 'advertise nothing'.
_comment_wallet: Currency balances shown in the top bar. 'vp' = Vive Points (purple). Theorycraft Coins (gold) is real-money premium and is not a virtual-wallet key.
_comment_heroes: Enabled hero codenames (lowercase). Empty = all 25 built-in heroes. These are marked owned so the ALL HUNTERS grid unlocks.

store._comment: SKUs advertised per storefront tab, keyed by the packed PrimaryAssetName. bundles=StoreOffer packs (BUNDLES + SUPPORTER PACKS), currency=real-money top-ups, featured=carousel, skins=HeroCosmeticsBundle, accessories=SlotCosmetics. Empty skins/accessories fall back to the full embedded lists (391 / 536).
